title: Combinatorial Geometry of Erdős--Szekeres Type Problems: SAT/ASP Modeling and Linear Subreduction
summary: This paper investigates several classical and novel variations of the Erdős--Szekeres problem, including multicolored point sets, convex hexagons with a given number of interior points, and polygons with constraints on edge colors. We propose a comprehensive computational framework combining combinatorial modeling within the SAT/ASP paradigms with the geometric realization of configurations.
